scope: Outcome-informed fixed-eight development repeated evaluation, additive to unchanged formal v1 and four-case diagnostic; CTRP sealed; no confirmatory independence claim
case_selection: All eight drugs from the original identity/coverage/dose-frozen panel; no outcome-based exclusion or substitution. Candidate/representation hypotheses are informed by historical formal-v1 and four-case diagnostic results.
split_rule: 626 frozen global biological groups, tissue-stratified folds, complete per-drug coverage intersection; all eight arms share the new five-fold splits in each repeat. Older result scores are historical, not direct paired controls.

feature.annotation_rule: Frozen unique protein_coding stable Ensembl IDs
feature.mad: Training log2(TPM+1) MAD>0, descending MAD then stable gene ID
feature.response_association: Training-only log2(TPM+1) and continuous AUC centered within training tissue; rank absolute Pearson residual correlation among detected genes with positive within-tissue expression residual sum of squares; exact zero target residual scores all zero; stable gene-ID tie break
feature.gene_column_order: stable gene ID ascending in all three representations; may differ numerically from v1 expression cyclic-coordinate order
feature.rank: Ascending average midrank within each sample and exactly the selected gene set; raw float64 exact ties; no all-transcriptome ranks or gene-wise normalization before ranking
feature.pair_full: Every unordered selected-gene pair, raw float64 sign -1/0/+1; no high-tie or training-constant pair deletion; retain zero-variance columns with deterministic scaler and zero fitted weights
feature.shortfall: Use all eligible genes up to the configured 200 or 2000 budget; record shortfall without changing selector or using heldout data
feature.empty_feature_fallback: Same-policy tissue_null (training tissue mean; unseen tissue training global mean), retain reason, samples and all outputs; distinct from historical v1 global-mean empty-feature fallback
feature.missing_rule: Only complete finite nonnegative float64 TPM; fail on unsupported input
feature.strong_expression_selector: Current-training detected positive logTPM-MAD genes, descending MAD with stable ID ties; 2000 budget; same stable-ID output order and same-policy EN/FWL as six molecular arms

elastic_net.standardization: Training-only feature/target mean and population SD; build representations before unpenalized tissue FWL projection
elastic_net.tissue_handling: Same unpenalized tissue FWL as formal v1; unseen tissue effect zero and molecular term retained
elastic_net.path_rule: Current fit residual X,y determine alpha_max; analytical zero molecular endpoint at ratio1; never borrow path across folds, drugs or permutations

tissue_null: Training tissue response mean; unseen tissue uses current training overall response mean; one fit per outer context, no HPO
tuning_objective: Minimum pooled inner OOF RMSE on assigned continuous response; first exact grid tie; all 10 candidates retained including null endpoint

permutation.unit: Unique frozen biological group; current cohort has exactly one model per group per drug, otherwise stop
permutation.algorithm: For each drug and permutation use numpy PCG64 SeedSequence([seed,drug_id,permutation_id]); sorted tissue then canonical IDs; permute response donors within tissue; mapping applies once to full drug data before all splits
permutation.shared_mapping: Same assigned y for every arm, outer fold and inner fit of that drug/permutation; both training and scoring use assigned y
permutation.singleton: Keep singleton tissues unchanged and report unpermutable groups, identity-donor and identical-response counts
permutation.scope: Observed labels only in this repeated run. Completed nine four-case full-pipeline null controls remain historical engineering evidence; no new permutation significance or eight-drug null claim.
permutation.control_metric: Molecular increment over same-policy tissue_null; tissue association may remain after restricted permutation
permutation.refit: Repeat response-aware gene screening, all inner model selection and outer refit for every permutation; no selected-gene or model reuse from observed labels

statistics.contrasts: 22 pairwise contrasts: six within-rule representation contrasts, three association-MAD contrasts, all seven molecular arms versus tissue_null, and all six 200-gene arms versus expression_strong. Three candidate-rule by representation difference-of-differences contrasts; each uses the same draw and complete repeat.
statistics.paired_direction: Spearman and R2 candidate-reference; RMSE and MAE reference-candidate so positive favors candidate
statistics.bootstrap_unit: All 626 frozen development biological groups; shared multiplicities across drugs/arms; exact reranked Spearman
statistics.confidence_scope: Outcome-informed development evaluation. Conditional OOF intervals with no feature-selection/tuning/train-refit uncertainty or guaranteed algorithmic CV coverage. Primary family9 and representation family18 adjustments have separate nominal family coverage, not whole-study coverage. Other metrics and contrasts descriptive unadjusted.
statistics.macro: Equal weights over the fixed eight drugs; if any drug/repeat point metric is undefined, retain NA and cause rather than nanmean or delete that drug/repeat
statistics.null_summary: No new null runs in this version; retain completed diagnostic null evidence without promoting nine draws to conventional significance
statistics.success: No winner, minimum-molecular-coefficient or drug-exclusion performance gate. Report effects, intervals, repeat variation, zero solutions, tissue increments and stability, with no score-driven redesign.
statistics.point_aggregation: Within each drug and arm, calculate metrics from each complete OOF repeat separately and take arithmetic mean of all three; never average predictions before ranking and never concatenate repeats to inflate N

primary_comparison.units: eight individual drugs plus equal-eight-drug macro
primary_comparison.adjustment: Bonferroni nominal conditional percentile intervals at family alpha 0.05

representation_family.units: two contrasts times eight individual drugs plus equal-eight-drug macro
representation_family.adjustment: Bonferroni nominal conditional percentile intervals at family alpha 0.05

statistics.interaction_scope: Descriptive pairwise-difference interactions; algebraically related, not independent tests and not causal shares of amplitude, dimension, collinearity or penalty

noninferiority.interpretation: No noninferiority, equivalence or complete information-preservation verdict. A future performance-retention question must predefine reference, justified margin, estimand, multiplicity and validated interval method.

resources.pressure_action: Before a task, wait boundedly; if insufficient resources persist exit resource_paused (75), preserving checkpoints and session provenance. Do not launch/kill a task based on its predictive score or alter model settings. RSS/private/system-commit sampled as operational observations, not isolated efficiency benchmarks.

failure_policy: Save failed checkpoint with traceback and partial audit then stop; resume only same frozen version after preserving failure; never omit failed task, zero solution, warning or weak drug
data_source: Completed historical formal-v1 prepared GDSC development responses, verified against immutable original-input metadata, then all fixed eight drugs; no CTRP response/index read. Original files and both historical run versions retained.
decision_rule: Full original eight-drug panel and all arms retained. Six-arm factorial estimates characterize candidate/representation interactions and learning constraints. No new minimum-useful-effect threshold or noninferiority margin is set. Final model/feature and external statistics freeze required before any CTRP access.
